```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())

library(readxl)
library(reshape2)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(scales)
library(fgsea)
library(data.table)
library(DESeq2)

library(org.Hs.eg.db)

result_folder = paste("./Results",format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d"),sep="/")
if (!file.exists(result_folder)) dir.create(result_folder, recursive=T)

```

```{r}
ref_folder = "/home/hilmar/Work/References/"
```


```{r, warning=FALSE}
load("./Results/2021-07-23/DGE_analysis_image.Rdata")

coldata <- ed[colnames(count_mat),]
rownames(coldata) <- coldata$sampleID
ddsHisatGE <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(count_mat, colData=coldata, design=~ Condition)
norm_count_mat = assay(varianceStabilizingTransformation(ddsHisatGE, blind=FALSE))
norm_counts = as.data.frame(norm_count_mat)
norm_counts = merge(norm_counts, gene_anno, by.x=0, by.y="Geneid", all.x=T, sort=F)
#norm_counts = read.table("./Results/2020-07-23/Normalized_expression_data.txt", sep="\t", header=T, stringsAsFactors = F)
#colnames(norm_counts) = gsub("Row.names", "Geneid", colnames(norm_counts))
```


```{r}
animal_db = fread(file.path(ref_folder, "genesets/misc/TF/AnimalDB-2015-02-17.txt"))
tfcat = read.table(file.path(ref_folder, "genesets/misc/TF/TFcat-2015-02-17.txt"), quote="", comment.char = "", fill=T, sep="\t",  header=T)

all_ids = unique(c(animal_db$`Gene ID`, tfcat$Gene.ID))

tf_symbols = select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys=all_ids, keytype = "ENTREZID", columns="SYMBOL")
tf_symbols = subset(tf_symbols, !is.na(SYMBOL))

tf_symbols_no_ZNF = subset(tf_symbols, !grepl("^ZNF", SYMBOL))
```

There are `r nrow(tf_symbols)` unique human transcription factors from AnimalDB (2015-02) and TFcat (2015-02).

```{r}
f1 <- function(x) {
  subset(x, padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 0.5 & GeneSymbol %in% tf_symbols_no_ZNF$SYMBOL)$GeneSymbol
}

all_sig_tf = unique(sort(unlist(lapply(all_results, f1))))
all_sig_tf_in_stomach_vs_gut = unique(sort(unlist(lapply(all_results[c("Colon_vs_NormalAntrum","Duodenum_vs_NormalAntrum")], f1))))
all_sig_tf_in_IM_vs_nonIM = unique(sort(unlist(lapply(all_results[names(all_results)[grepl("^IM_", names(all_results))]], f1))))

all_sig_joint_IM_and_gut_vs_stomach = intersect(all_sig_tf_in_IM_vs_nonIM, all_sig_tf_in_stomach_vs_gut)

```


```{r}
all_fc = lapply(all_results, function(x) {tmp = subset(x, GeneSymbol %in% all_sig_joint_IM_and_gut_vs_stomach)[, c("GeneSymbol","log2FoldChange")]; rownames(tmp)= tmp$GeneSymbol; tmp[["GeneSymbol"]] <- NULL; tmp } ) 
all_fc_mat = as.matrix(do.call(cbind, all_fc))
colnames(all_fc_mat) <- names(all_fc)
```


```{r, fig.height=12, fig.width=12}
pheatmap(all_fc_mat, breaks = c(-25,-10,-5, seq(-3, 3, 6/94), 5, 10, 25))
pheatmap(all_fc_mat[, c("IM_vs_non-IM_all_samples","IM_all_vs_NormalAntrum","Colon_vs_NormalAntrum","Duodenum_vs_NormalAntrum")], breaks = c(-25,-10,-5, seq(-3, 3, 6/94), 5, 10, 25))
```

<!-- # Selected tissue specific, SC and IM-related gene sets -->


<!-- The following gene sets are used for visualizations: -->

<!-- - Munoz et al Small Intestinal Stem Cell Signature (PMID: 22692129, DOI: 10.1038/emboj.2012.166, Supp Table S3 ) -->
<!-- - Mallon et al StemCellDB (PMID: 23117585) -->
<!-- - Herbst et al Beta-catenine target genes (PMID: 24467841) -->
<!-- - Palmer et al 'Pluripotency' Signature (PMID: 22909066, DOI: doi: 10.1186/gb-2012-13-8-r71). The modules defined by Palmer et al are as follows -->
<!--       - 1 - DNA replication / cell cycle module -->
<!--       - 2 - RNA transcription / protein synthesis module -->
<!--       - 3 - metabolism / hormone signaling / protein synthesis module -->
<!--       - 4 - multicellular signaling / immune signaling / cell identity module -->
<!-- - Colon vs. Stomach signature (generated by using data from colon biobank normal tissues [van Wetering et al., PMID: 25957691] and gastric glands [Bartfeld et al ,PMID: 25307862]; see /data/public_data/GSE64392_colon_biobank/ for details ) -->
<!-- - IM vs healthy signature (strongly up- or downregulated genes in complete and incomplete IM vs healthy control using GE data published by Companioni O 2017 PlosOne [doi: 10.1371/journal.pone.0176043]; see /data_genome2/public_data/GSE78523_IM_GC for details) -->
<!-- - Gut tissue specific gene sets derived from Protein Atlas (proteinatlas.org) tissue specific gene lists. Those consist of tissue enriched (>5 fold higher mRNA compared to all other tissues), group enriched (>5 fold higher mRNA in 2-7 tissues compared to rest) and tissue enhanced (>5 fold higher mRNA to average in rest). We only include *tissue enriched* and *group enriched* genes. -->
